updates.how: The sidepod inlet has been revised aiming at improved flow conditioning towards the rear of the car for improved aerodynamic performance.

updates.change: Revised Engine Cover and Coke Line
updates.how: The engine cover and coke line have been revised in conjunction with the new sidepod inlet enhancing the flow conditioning downstream.
An alternative sidepod shape is available as an option for the aforementioned bodywork, resulting in a change of resultant aerodynamic properties.
As part of the new bodywork package, cooling louvre layout and position have been altered for maximum aerodynamic performance at various cooling levels.
The flow conditioning changes from the bodywork are utilised by a revised floor edge design, resulting in improved aerodynamic performance.
In conjunction with the floor edge, the diffuser has been revised, aiming at extracting more aerodynamic performance from the new flow topology.
The changes in upstream aerodynamic flow conditions incentivise a modification to the rear suspension fairings to maximise aerodynamic performance.

updates.change: Alternative Straight Line Mode Flap Position
updates.how: The medium isochronal rear wing has been modified to deploy the flap to an alternative position in straight line mode, resulting in a larger reduction in drag.
The realisation of development iterations sees a new floor geometry with subtle changes within the permitted geometry to extract more local load whilst maintaining flow stability.

updates.change: Revised split line to the floor
updates.how: Accompanying the new floor, the sidepod has been revised with a new junction or split line to the floor, to supplement the floor changes yielding more local load.
To blend the new sidepod to existing surrounding geometry, the cooling louvres have been revised whilst maintaining the range of cooling levels offered previously.
Also accompanying the floor and sidepod, the mirror assembly geometry has been revised to aid the downstream conditioning and supplement the local load increase.
A small change to revise a turning vane on the fairing to better serve downstream components, the flow stability and therefore load generation.

updates.change: An updated Floor Bodywork Assembly has been introduced, including new Floor Leading Edge devices, Floor Body and Floor Corner geometry.
updates.how: We have modified the forward and outboard regions of the floor to extract more performance both locally and across the main underfloor surfaces.

updates.change: A revised Tail geometry has been introduced to suit the new Floor update.
updates.how: The new surfaces work together with the new floor to generate increased performance locally around the RIS.

updates.change: Reprofiled surfaces have been applied to the Front Brake Duct flow conditioning devices.
updates.how: The forward and rearward regions of the Front Wheel Bodywork have been updated to offer both improved interaction with the Front Wing and an improved downstream flow field with the rest of the car.

updates.change: A change in suspension cladding orientation.
updates.how: To suit the new onset flow, the surfaces on the rear suspension have been realigned to offer additional performance in the rear corner.

updates.change: The Rear Brake Duct furniture has been modified with new leading edge features.
updates.how: The previously described geometry changes have unlocked a new flow field opportunity in the rear corner and we have been able to extract additional performance in this region by retuning these devices.
The new front wing geometry helps establish a clean flow field, which leads to improved performance from the components downstream of it.

updates.change: New brake duct and front lip
updates.how: Working in conjunction with the new front wing, the front corner & suspension updates help manage the flow downstream and around the car, allowing the floor to perform effectively.
